Class QNSolver

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.QNSolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
QNSolverInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
CoMoMSolver, MoMSolver, MonteCarloLogisticSolver, MonteCarloSolver, RecursiveSolver, RGFSolver, TreeConvolutionSolver, TreeMVASolver
public class QNSolver extends Object implements QNSolverInterface
Class which defines several methods every QNSolver object must support. It provides generic implementation of common operations, such as initialisation, evaluation and returning the results.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010
